# Python Helper

The Python Helper layer provides utilities and scripts for Python-related tasks.

## Overview

This layer includes various scripts and functions for analyzing and verifying Python source code. It helps in understanding the structure, complexity, and importance of Python files.

## Responsibilities

- **Code Analysis**: Analyzes Python files to determine their structure, complexity, and importance.

## Key components

| File | Purpose | Main definitions |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`src/analyze.js`](../src/analyze.js) | Analyzes lines of code to determine per-line facts. | `analyzeLines`, `lineStarts`, `matchToken`, `splitLines`, `lineIndexAt`, `baseInfo` |
| [`src/folders.js`](../src/folders.js) | Manages folder structures and purposes. | `FOLDER_SCHEMA`, `MAX_FILES_PER_CALL`, `callLabel`, `callTokens`, `dirOf`, `digestLine` |
| [`src/importance.js`](../src/importance.js) | Orders existing code by importance. | `complexity`, `importSpecifiers`, `isEntryPoint`, `packageEntries`, `rankFiles`, `resolveImport` |
| [`src/process.js`](../src/process.js) | Exports and uses constants and functions related to document processing. | `DOCS_PASS_RESERVE_MINUTES`, `DOCS_RESERVE_MINUTES`, `README_RESERVE_MINUTES`, `deadlines`, `docsReserveMinutes`, `docsToRewrite` |
| [`src/python-helper.py`](../src/python-helper.py) | Analyzes and verifies Python source for Docturnal. | `analyze`, `dump`, `env_names`, `verify`, `main`, `_dotted` |
| [`src/python.js`](../src/python.js) | Runs src/python-helper.py with python3 to analyze and verify Python source. | `analyzePython`, `findPython`, `pythonEnvNames`, `verifyPython`, `runHelper` |
| [`src/structure.js`](../src/structure.js) | Analyzes the structure of files. | `commentPurpose`, `fileStructure`, `leadingComment`, `structuralSummary`, `symbolsOf`, `basename` |

## How it works

- **src/analyze.js**: This file contains functions for analyzing lines of code, determining per-line facts, and managing code and comment structures.
